description: Ministry of Ports and Shipping - Merchant Shipping (Safety of Navigation) Regulations No. 6 of 2021 (Reserved)
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Ports and Shipping under the Merchant Shipping Act, establishing new legal/regulatory frameworks for maritime safety and navigation.
